description:
Digging green‑onion crops out of soil by hand is extremely labor‑intensive and slow work. This tracked‑drive green onion harvester has completely transformed large‑scale shallot harvesting.
Powered by a heavy‑duty diesel engine, the machine travels steadily along the planting ridge. Its digging blade goes deep underground to loosen the soil around onion roots, lifting whole stalks out of the earth without cutting or damaging them.
The wide crawler tracks spread weight evenly, preventing the machine from sinking into soft wet farmland soil. It works perfectly for large‑scale green‑onion fields and drastically cuts down harvest‑season labour costs.
This on‑site farm video captures the harvester working in mature green‑onion rows. If you are struggling with slow, back‑breaking manual onion digging, this powerful harvesting equipment will greatly speed‑up your harvest work.
